lower.admissionMessage: Error from server: error when creating "STDIN": admission webhook "vpol.validate.kyverno.svc-fail" denied the request: Policy uid-probe-priv failed: Privileged mode is disallowed. All containers must set the securityContext.privileged field to `false` or unset the field.

conclusion: Kyverno 1.19.2 cannot bind a native PolicyException to a namespace UID: namespaceObject.metadata.uid is rejected at exception creation (the Kubernetes CEL Namespace type declares the field as UID), and namespaceObject.metadata.UID compiles but fails at evaluation (no such key: UID), so admission errors closed and background reports error. Only the namespace name can be matched. A recreated namespace with the same name would therefore inherit a native grant; native exception enablement stays blocked on this as well as on the expiry gap.
